MTTD = time from real problem start -> alert fires
MTTA = time from alert fires -> human acknowledges
MTTR = time from acknowledgment -> actually resolved

# A high combined number could mean any ONE of these --
# and each one needs a completely different fix.
caption: High MTTD = monitoring gap. High MTTA = paging/fatigue. High MTTR = tooling/runbooks.
